brand_identity.logo_treatment: Typography-based logo. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' font, 'font-black tracking-tighter'. 'Runiq' in high-contrast Black (text-zinc-950), 'Insight' in muted Gray (text-zinc-500).
brand_identity.vibe: Sophisticated, Data-Focused, Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth). Minimalist.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-tight text-zinc-950
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-zinc-400

layouts.dashboard_grid: High density, modular. Use 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4' with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding inside containers (p-6, p-8) to prevent text collision. Follow standard Tailwind scale.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align most content. Top-left quadrant for the most important metric (Modified F-pattern).
layouts.navigation: Collapsible left sidebar (w-64) for navigation. Clean top header for search/profile.

components.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px solid border (border-zinc-200), no shadows. Subtle rounded-lg.
components.buttons: Sleek, high contrast. Primary: bg-zinc-950 text-white hover:bg-zinc-800. Secondary: bg-white border border-zinc-200 text-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-50. Pill-shaped or rounded-md.
components.kpi_cards: Top left metric label, massive number (text-4xl font-black), small trend indicator below. Use grid-borders (border-r, border-b) for technical feel.
components.business_insights: Feed list layout. Severity badges (red, orange, blue). Structure: WHAT (h3), WHY (muted body text), ACTION (accent button or bold link).
components.ask_runiq: Conversational UI. User bubbles: bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-900. AI bubbles: bg-white border border-zinc-200. Monospace for data snippets.
components.upload_zone: Large dashed border area, muted background (bg-zinc-50), centered clear CTA. Use minimal lucide icons.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on border-zinc-200 to separate elements. Only use shadow-sm for active/floating states.
visual_enhancers.motion: Subtle. Hover: bg color shift, -translate-y-[1px] for interactive cards. Smooth transitions for sidebar.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data sections. Use only for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-zinc-200). DO NOT use transparent backgrounds over content.

welcome_background.description: Minimal desk workspace - use as a subtle background or illustration for the empty state / welcome screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install @fontsource/inter or use Google Fonts import for Inter and JetBrains Mono. Use Fontshare API for Cabinet Grotesk.
Implement a collapsible left sidebar layout with a fixed top header.
Ensure 'Business Insights' prioritizes text and actionable recommendations over excessive charting. Design this as a feed.
Use Recharts for the 'Revenue trend over time' chart, keeping it minimal (no grid lines, simple tooltip, use stroke-zinc-900).
Implement Shadcn UI for standard components (buttons, inputs, cards, tables).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded) with interaction animations.
NEVER use placeholder text for images.
